current.text: Landale re-signed with Atlanta on a 1-year, 14 million USD deal.
He is the backup center behind Onyeka Okongwu and part of a 10-man bench rotation.
Atlanta's center depth is thin: Veesaar is out for the season and Gueye is injured.
If Okongwu got hurt, Landale would start and play 30-plus minutes. That makes him the best stash on the team, but only in deep stash formats.
One expert calls him an okay backup center and questions the size of his contract.

durable.text: He is a center who can shoot, so Atlanta always has a shooting center on the floor. This fits Quin Snyder's five-out offense, which wants lots of threes.
Steals are a clear weak spot. He is projected well below the league in steals.

tags.name: handcuff
tags.detail: Backup to Onyeka Okongwu. Would start and play 30-plus minutes if Okongwu is out.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Stash value only in deep leagues. In our league, add him if Okongwu misses time.

note: Landale is Yahoo rank 282 with a 0 USD value and no ESPN price, so he is not one of the 144 players we draft. His 2025-26 line in 22.2 minutes (10.6 PTS, 5.7 REB, 0.5 STL, 0.5 BLK) shows little value in 9-cat when he comes off the bench, and his steals are a clear weak spot. Leave him on waivers and watch Okongwu's health early in the season, because an Okongwu injury would make Landale a 30-minute starter worth a FAB bid.
